create_mcp_server: create a new MCP server record in the database with credentials, approval status, and metadata
get_all_mcp_servers: get all MCP servers from the database, optionally filtered by approval status
store_user_oauth_credential: store an OAuth2 access token and refresh token for a specific user and server pair
refresh_user_oauth_token: refresh an expired OAuth2 access token using the stored refresh token and server token URL
get_mcp_submissions: get all submitted MCP servers with a summary count breakdown by approval status
